ownRead.title: AI
ownRead.description: An open claim retained by the selected v0.2.1 companion.
ownRead.statement: **O8 — AI.** Persistent dynamic modules and activity-dependent relations suggest a possible architecture. In this release no RRG AI model is benchmarked and no gain in intelligence, transfer or efficiency is established. A later contribution should distinguish stable activity from useful prediction or learning. This proposal remains available without becoming a proof requirement for the physics framework.
ownRead.scope: Source-reported open claim, not a demonstrated result or a required proof before publication.
ownRead.body:
## Investigate one part

A stable pattern can still be computationally unhelpful. The mathematical programme proposes specific model experiments, while the general AI application remains open. A contribution should state its task, prediction or learning measure and comparison, and distinguish useful performance from persistence alone. No project benchmark result is claimed here.

Bring a source passage, model, result or objection to [the contribution route](/about/#contribute). You can address this question without accepting the entire proposal. Read [all open questions](/open-problems/) for the surrounding programme.
